world.title: Signals of Renewal
world.concept: A coastal research garden where ten imagined developments appear as distinct landmarks connected by water, paths, terraces, and restored habitats.
world.setting: A continuous alpine-to-ocean landscape with a sheltered lagoon, rocky terraces, glass gardens, wetlands, forested slopes, and a distant observatory.
world.timeOfDay: Clear early morning with a low warm sun, long soft shadows, and cool open sky.
world.atmosphere: Curious, constructive, calm, and quietly cinematic, with enough realism to make every object spatially legible.
world.navigation: Use a looping path and waterways to connect foreground, middle ground, and distant landmarks with open sightlines and unmistakable silhouettes.

subjects.subject: A monumental luminous DNA helix rising through a circular glass botanical pavilion
subjects.placement: at the center of the middle ground
subjects.scale: the tallest nearby landmark without blocking the horizon

subjects.subject: A crystalline coastal lagoon with visible coral nurseries and submerged geodesic growing domes
subjects.scale: a broad navigable habitat occupying much of the foreground

subjects.subject: Three cylindrical energy vessels beside a small group of wind turbines
subjects.scale: large enough to read clearly but secondary to the central helix

subjects.subject: A sequence of circular filtration pools flowing into constructed wetlands
subjects.scale: a connected system visible as a descending chain

subjects.subject: A regenerating native forest marked by young trees and translucent protective forms
subjects.scale: a wide gradient from seedlings to mature trees

subjects.subject: A small penguin colony on a protected ice shelf
subjects.placement: at the far-left boundary between ocean and rock
subjects.scale: small but readable as a grouped silhouette

subjects.subject: A compact Earth-observation satellite tracing a fine orbital arc
subjects.placement: high in the open sky away from the panorama seam
subjects.scale: small but distinct against clean sky

subjects.subject: A compact non-humanoid field rover tending a flowering garden
subjects.scale: close enough to show its tool-like form

subjects.subject: Warm glass pollinator pavilions embedded in linked flowering terraces
subjects.placement: along the eastern foreground and middle-ground paths

subjects.subject: A white astronomical observatory with one open dome
subjects.placement: on the highest distant mountain at the right

required: one continuous environment with coherent terrain and lighting
all ten subjects visually distinct and separated
strong silhouettes and readable physical materials
open navigable paths and layered spatial depth
prohibited: people, faces, portraits, crowds, or humanoid robots
written text, labels, logos, flags, UI, borders, or watermarks
split panels, floating collage fragments, or duplicated landmarks
graphic violence, catastrophe spectacle, advertising, or clickbait imagery
